falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes above 35 for two consecutive days

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y Treasury yield drops below 3.80% while S&P 500 is also down >2% week-over-week
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: This flight-to-safety divergence would prove the equity decline is driven by recession fear rather than rate repricing, breaking the macro logic of the 2024 August bottom which was a rates-driven correction with growth holding
